tool_args.rationale: The pilot shows monotone concavity and a sink-gradient signature, but its gradient span is only about 0.018. A gradient-discriminating observation is the smallest relevant acquisition to separate sink-coupled and open-branch candidate laws; no observed signature warrants abstention.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a sink-coupled saturation law now (node C/D, Q, or R)
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The five pilot rows vary u_now but hold s_grad near 1, so inhibition and open-branch effects are not identifiable; the archive specifically calls for this probe when the gradient span is below 0.08.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a one-variable concave saturation law
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: It may explain the observed u_now curve, but cannot establish whether the sink-gradient dependence is present.
The observed signatures and H=0.6 do not point to a coupled-memory ODE requiring trajectory data.
